scope: Repair only the pixel visibility/topology of the three existing v4 armed-confirm shape roles in the four failed profiles and reserve a non-overlapping leading focus slot. Preserve authority, rules, exact actor/action copy, submission, placement, controls, inherited thresholds, and exposure state.

row_foreground_contrast.measurement_surface: Final composited CPU raster pixels for the role outline/strokes against the actual local armed/confirm row background after alpha, clip, and draw order.

focus_chevron.geometry: Two diagonal strokes joined at one apex as one independently recognizable chevron component.
focus_chevron.placement: A dedicated leading slot inside the focused confirm hit rectangle, separated from Player HUD geometry, selected/confirm trailing slots, and text glyphs.

selected_check_diamond.geometry: One visible closed four-sided diamond outline enclosing the visible check glyph.
selected_check_diamond.placement: Existing armed action trailing role slot only; absent from every open/unselected/control state.

confirm_double_frame_plus_enter_arrow.geometry: Two visible closed nested rectangular frames enclosing a visible bent enter-arrow glyph.
confirm_double_frame_plus_enter_arrow.placement: Existing explicit confirm trailing role slot only; absent from action/open/status/error/control states.

copy_and_interaction_freeze: Preserve the exact localized armed and confirm actor/action strings and their source from the stable offer actor/action result.

A leading content inset may move the unchanged confirm glyph run only enough to reserve the focus slot; no wording, localization, wrapping limit, ellipsis, row order, hit rectangle, focus target, arm, confirm, cancel, or submission semantic change is authorized.
All three roles must remain simultaneously visible before submission, with distinct token attribution and non-overlapping role masks.

raster_contract: Rasterize the real ProductUiFrame HudDrawList into a deterministic CPU RGB(A) surface at every required physical resolution, preserving production primitive/triangle stream order, alpha compositing, safeRect clipping, glyph clipping, and profile density/uiScale.
Export final composited pixels plus token-attributed role masks and text masks. A role mask is diagnostic attribution only; every pass decision must also be observed in the final composited pixels.

Run the same final-pixel topology checks for standard, color_vision_safe, and deterministic protanopia, deuteranopia, and tritanopia transforms. Non-color geometry/closure/component results must remain invariant.
No token declaration, nominal bbox, triangle count, source constant, or synthetic shape_contract boolean may substitute for final-raster evidence.
topology_algorithm_requirements: Connected-component analysis is performed on final foreground pixels in each dedicated role slot; components touching text or an unrelated HUD mask fail.
Closed outlines are proven by border flood-fill on final composited pixels: the selected outline isolates an interior and the two confirm frames expose two nested enclosure levels.
Open or missing edge segments, accent-on-accent, alpha zero, clipping, later overwrite, role aliasing, undersize, text collision, or a bare glyph must fail closed.
Snapshot files, per-role masks, physical dimensions, profile metadata, pixel/topology metrics, and stable SHA aggregates are mandatory evidence.

machine_and_static_gate.required_reproducibility: Two clean offline runs must produce byte-identical ordered 540-case results, CPU raster snapshot metrics, and stable aggregates.
requirements: All inherited 540-case authority/action/copy/layout/contrast/performance/placement checks remain enabled at their existing values.
The four repair cases pass every CPU final-raster contrast, component, closure, enclosure, size, clip/order, and CVD transform check.
The twelve snapshot controls preserve copy/layout/status/placement visuals and reject v4/v5 token leakage.
Static diff inspection confines changes to the explicit allowlist and rejects authority/rules/copy/placement/threshold/exposure drift.
Token/bbox/triangle checks remain supporting diagnostics and are never counted as pixel-visible acceptance.

production_files.allowed: Only reserve the dedicated group_choice_armed_confirm focus slot and inset the unchanged confirm glyph run without changing row/hit semantics.
Only the three existing v4 role foreground colors/primitive parameters needed for final-pixel contrast and closure; no placement/world or unrelated UI raster path.

test_and_evidence_categories: Deterministic CPU HudDrawList raster snapshot implementation and role/text mask instrumentation.
Rules UI v5 540-machine integration, pixel/topology validator, negative fixtures, and future readiness/evidence validation.
No shipping asset, font, palette token shared with Player HUD/shell, capture image, frozen receipt, or prior evidence mutation.

forbidden_changes.authority_rules: No ruleset, offered action inventory/order, branch, clause, actor, foundation action, authority hash/revision, request/ACK identity, validation, idempotency, mutation, turn, score, rack, breaker, group, or entitlement change.
forbidden_changes.copy_interaction: No actor/action wording, locale mapping, wrapping limit, ellipsis, row/control order, hit rectangle, focus target, arm/confirm/cancel/submit behavior, or input semantic change.
forbidden_changes.placement_controls: No ghost cue-ball, crosshair, invalid octagon, dashed ring, behind-head hatch/boundary/copy/coordinate, placement region, submitting, error, open/unselected, pending, stale, disabled, or unoffered visual/behavior change.
forbidden_changes.thresholds: No inherited contrast, text, critical-shape, stroke, hit-target, safe-area, layout, occlusion, ui-scale, viewport/density, performance, draw-call, or evidence threshold relaxation or replacement. The v5 4.0:1 row-outline constraint is supplemental and stricter, not a relaxation.
forbidden_changes.exposure_evidence: No overwrite of frozen v2/v3/v4 evidence; no product exposure, profile-complete, Golden, M2, Beta, real-input, screen-reader, external-human, implementation-pass, machine-pass, GPU-pass, or TA-pass claim from this design gate.

preconditions: 540/540 machine and all 16 CPU raster snapshots pass twice reproducibly with source/binary/snapshot hashes frozen.
Every required negative raster fixture fails closed and static diff scope passes.
A new readiness package records all 16 cases NOT_RUN; a separate single-use root authorization is required and is not issued here.
capture_requirements: Fresh process, production Core 4.1 product_ui path after ACES tone map, shipping fonts, exact 4 repair plus 12 controls.
Bind PPM and byte-faithful PNG paths/SHA/physical dimensions, source/binary/runner/auth lineage, render order, role masks/metrics, and stable aggregates.
Machine 16/16 is required with zero token leakage, copy/layout/placement/status regression, or inherited threshold drift.
future_targeted_actual_gpu_gate.proof_boundary: Future GPU machine pass closes only sampled raster execution. It does not equal independent TA, product, Golden, M2, Beta, real-input, screen-reader, or external-human pass.

future_technical_art_gate.reviewer: Independent technical artist who did not implement v5.
requirements: Open every future frozen PNG at original physical resolution and decide all ten axes per image; do not inherit machine or v4 findings as PASS.

For all four repair images, visually distinguish the reserved leading chevron, closed selected diamond enclosing its check, and two closed confirm frames enclosing the bent arrow in standard/CVD without relying on hue.
All twelve controls must show zero regression and zero v4/v5 token leakage. Any remaining prior failure or any new failure blocks v5.

acceptance.implementation_may_start_when: All six bindings match and the implementation is confined to the two production allowlist entries plus test/evidence scaffolding.
acceptance.v5_scoped_visual_may_pass_when: Two reproducible 540/540 machine plus 16/16 CPU raster snapshot runs pass, separately authorized future targeted GPU is 16/16 machine PASS, and independent TA decides 160/160 axes PASS with all eight prior failures repaired and zero regressions.
